title: Ulla, Son of Rav Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was Rav Yosef’s colleague. In Shevuot 30a, Ulla has a case before Rav Nachman, and Rav Yosef sends word: “Ulla is our colleague, a peer in Torah.” In Bava Kamma 7a, Abaye raises a difficulty against him.
He is mentioned in halakhic passages: Shabbat 129a, Beitzah 22a, Bava Kamma 7a, Zevachim 11b.
